auth.tagline: Everything arranged for your loved ones — offline and private
auth.erfgenaamLink: I am an heir (unlock with emergency codes)

profiel.geenProfielen: Create your first profile to get started.
profiel.selecterenMislukt: Failed to select profile. Please try again.
profiel.aanmakenMislukt: Failed to create profile. Check whether the name already exists.

setup.beschrijving: Choose a strong password to secure your data. This password encrypts everything locally on this device.
setup.disclaimer: Your data is stored encrypted. Keep your password safe — without it, your data cannot be accessed.
setup.foutMinimaal: Password must contain at least 8 characters.
setup.foutSetup: Failed to create database. Check write permissions and try again.
setup.wachtwoordWaarschuwing: Store your password, emergency codes, and recovery codes in a safe place. Losing your password means losing access to all your Lumio data.
setup.avgConsentLabelVervolg: and agree to the processing of my personal data.
setup.avgConsentFout: You must agree to the privacy statement to continue.
setup.avgModalTitel: Privacy Statement — your data in Lumio
setup.avgModalP1: Lumio stores your personal data exclusively locally on this device, encrypted with AES-256. Lumio has no access to your data and never sends data to a server or cloud service.
setup.avgModalP2: Lumio may process special categories of personal data including health data (euthanasia directive, donor registration) based on your explicit consent (GDPR art. 9(2)(a)).
setup.avgModalP3: You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting your account via Settings → Delete account. All data will then be permanently erased.
setup.avgModalP4: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data. Your data is retained until you delete your account.
setup.avgModalVerantwoordelijke: Data controller: Lumio (personal use, no external processors for your content).

ontgrendel.beschrijving: Enter your password to access your digital legacy.
ontgrendel.mislukt: Incorrect password. Check your password and try again.
ontgrendel.wachtwoordVergetenTekst: Access to your Lumio archive cannot be restored without the password. This is a deliberate security choice to protect your data.
ontgrendel.geblokkerd: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in {minuten, plural, one {1 minute} other {# minutes}}.
ontgrendel.erfgenaamKnop: I don't have a password — I am an heir

erfgenaam.beschrijving: Enter the emergency codes to reconstruct the master password. You need at least the threshold number of codes.
erfgenaam.instructie: Enter your emergency codes below. You need at least {drempel} codes to gain access.
erfgenaam.minimaalCodes: At least {drempel} emergency codes are required.
erfgenaam.reconstructieMislukt: Reconstruction failed. Please verify that you have entered enough valid emergency codes.
erfgenaam.introBeschrijving: To access this Lumio archive you need emergency codes. The owner has securely split their master password using the Shamir method.
erfgenaam.introStap1: Collect at least {drempel} emergency codes from the designated heirs.
erfgenaam.introStap2: Enter each code separately on the next screen.
erfgenaam.introStap3: Once enough codes are entered, the archive will be unlocked.
erfgenaam.reconstructieMisluktStap1: Check that you have entered the correct number of emergency codes.
erfgenaam.reconstructieMisluktStap2: Verify that each code has been copied completely and correctly.
erfgenaam.reconstructieMisluktStap3: Contact another designated heir for the missing code.

sessie.alleenLezenBeschrijving: You are logged in as an heir. Data can only be viewed and exported, not modified.
